text:
rachael: Opening a tiny PR to harmonize audit export UI wording, CLI examples, and the C# SDK snippet. Goal: a single retention blurb across API reference, Console, and the auditor evidence playbook. Need legal + a short C# example.

tom: Can you paste proposed copy?

rachael: Draft: "Retention is configured per customer account; by default audit records are retained for 90 days. Audit exports created for audits or legal obligations will be preserved in line with applicable law and contractual requirements."

jen: That reads fine but change "customer" -> "customer account" (you already did). Also prefer "in accordance with" instead of "in line with". Minor wording: end sentence -> "... preserved in accordance with applicable law or contractual obligations."

mike: I'll add a small C# snippet for the SDK section. Draft:
```csharp
// C# audit export sample
var res = await client.Audit.ExportAsync(fromIso, toIso, retentionHint: "90d");
Console.WriteLine(res.Items.Count);
```

rachael: Nice. Also adding a short "evidence package" section showing fields auditors expect: audit_event.category, timestamp_iso, service.context.name, metadata.data_subject_request_id, and metadata.legal_hold.

tom: Can we include a short CLI sanity check using jq for QA? e.g., `jq '.items[] | {ts:.timestamp, category:.audit_event.category, svc:.service.context.name, legal:.metadata.legal_hold}' export.json`

jen: Add note that exports are scoped to the requesting customer account unless cross-tenant access is explicitly granted. And include a reminder not to log signed URLs.

docs-bot: PR #5401 opened by rachael: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5401 :bookmark_tabs:

rachael: Plan: merge after legal sign-off and a quick QA pass. Tagging infra for the export-agent bump. Thanks! :thumbsup:
